Coram : MARKANDEY KATJU*, GYAN SUDHA MISRA
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: s.482 A B Quashing of proceedings - Allegation against the C government doctors that they indulged in private practice in the evening at their residence and charged consultation fee from patients which was contrary to the government rules - FIR lodged under the under /PC - High Court declined to quash the FIR - On appeal, o held: The demand/receipt of fee by a medical professional for extending medical help by itself cannot be held to be an illegal gratification as the amount so charged is towards professional remuneration - If, however, it is alleged
Decision Date : 28-04-2011 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1041/2011 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
